_comment: ISP-121 (AB#813): Sol's NPC corporations and the authorities, from docs/design/npc-corporations.md (AB#812). Every name here, and every system sender and standing-order buyer, is reserved at registration (server/npcCorporations.js). The standing orders still name their buyers in data/economy.json npcBuyers until the follow-up moves them onto this roster.

authorities.name: GEX Commodities Authority
authorities.role: Settles every trade on the Galactic Exchange and keeps the exchange tax; does not trade.

authorities.name: Earth Assembly
authorities.role: Ratified the ISP; sets the framework the ISA regulates within.

authorities.name: Station Administration
authorities.role: Runs Sol's stations: docking, offices, property.

authorities.name: Intergalactic Stock Exchange Authority
authorities.role: Regulates equity markets for corporate shares.

authorities.name: ISA Materials Exchange
authorities.role: Today's Carbon buyer name; dropped as a trading name, kept reserved so no player can take it.

corporations.name: Meridian Glassworks
corporations.flavour: Makes the glass, insulation and aerogel panels every station in Sol is skinned with; always short of Silicates.

corporations.name: Lunar Helium Consortium
corporations.flavour: A cartel of the old Luna fusion operators; buys every litre of Helium-3 that reaches the Gateway and resells to the reactors.

corporations.name: Belt Refining Cooperative
corporations.flavour: Smelters owned by the belt crews who sell to them; takes Nickel by the ton at the Dock.

corporations.name: Olympus Heavy Industries
corporations.flavour: Builds hulls and habitat frames in the yards above Olympus Mons; Titanium is its bottleneck.

corporations.name: Tycho Carbon Works
corporations.flavour: Spins carbon fibre for freight hulls at Tycho, fed through the Gateway.

corporations.name: Synthorium Trading House
corporations.flavour: An old trading house that brokers Rare Earths to Earth's electronics firms, and buys from anyone.
